description: This file defines the ModuleCache class, which manages the caching and retrieval of build modules within the Android IDE generation tools. It handles module initialization, lookup by directory or name, and maintains internal data structures for module storage.

classes.name: ModuleCache
classes.description: Class responsible for caching build modules, providing methods to initialize, retrieve, and store modules based on directory or name.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ModuleCache.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the cache with an index file, building module indexes.

methods.name: getAndCacheByDir
methods.description: Retrieves a Module object based on directory, creating and caching it if necessary.

methods.name: getAndCacheByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Module by name, resolving makefile location, and caching it.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a Module to the cache.
